blocks.text: PENKOVSKY KNEW A LOT OF FILES.|PERHAPS HIS.
COLONEL PENKOVSKY IS ARRESTED, A GRU OFFICER|WHO WAS SPYING FOR LONDON AND WASHINGTON.
HE IS AFRAID: IF PENKOVSKY HAS TALKED, THE FBI MAY KNOW|THAT HE HAS BEEN PLAYING FOR MOSCOW ALL ALONG.
WE'VE READ|YOUR MESSAGE.|WE NEED TO TALK.
GOING HOME MEANS HIS FAMILY.|AND MAYBE THE FIRING SQUAD.
